    Representations supported in a subpiece #

    Let T ⊆ S. A representation of the piece of S is supported in T if it vanishes at the points outside T. Morphisms between restrictions of such representations extend by zero (extHomP). So restriction reflects isomorphism (iso_of_resP_iso) and preserves indecomposability (isIndec_resP) for representations supported in T.
